Network Service Resource Get Network Services Lite
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/networkServices/lite

Gets a name and ID dictionary of all network services.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
locale
string
Default value: en_US
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
